description: List logical downloadable outputs for an owned model, asset pack, material, Image, or video/audio asset without returning direct download URLs. Returns stable artifact IDs, semantic roles, labels, formats, filenames, content types, byte sizes when known, trustworthy Image dimensions or video/audio duration when known, and downloadability/reason. Use before get_asset_artifact for one chosen file, or use get_asset_artifact_manifest for code-project imports that need all ready files with durable URLs and paths.
name: list_asset_artifacts
title: List Asset Artifacts
